title: 'Add music…' opens no file picker (3 tries: click, click again, keyboard Enter)
wanted: Bring my trip-music.mp3 into the film with the Audio tab's 'Add music…'
did: Audio tab › Add music… (tooltip: 'Bring in a music file … from this computer'); clicked twice, then focused it and pressed Enter
happened: No file picker ever appeared and nothing changed in the panel: no message, no error. Same symptom as last round's Import › Upload Files…. It may be my rig's browser not showing the OS picker (automation), but the two other buttons in this tool that open pickers behaved the same, so a real person may hit it too.
expected: An OS file picker; then the track in the 'Music bed' dropdown
suggestion: If the picker cannot open, say so on screen and point to the path box

title: First pass turned GX010474 sideways: Rotation -90° and Scale 178 on top of the tool's own upright fix
wanted: Shot 1 (GX010474, airport bar) upright in the film, as the Source monitor now shows it
did: Accepted cut as I found it; parked at 0:00, 0:20, 2:15, 4:10, 6:06; selected shot 1 and opened Effect Controls
happened: Source monitor and the Effect Controls thumbnail show GX010474 upright (last round's fix works there), but the Program monitor shows it lying on its side and zoomed to fill the frame. Effect Controls says Motion Scale 178.0, Rotation -90.0° on shot 1: someone (the first pass, I never touched it) 'corrected' a rotation the tool had already corrected, so it is now turned twice. Odd extra: the very first frame I saw after load (001/003) was upright, then it went sideways after the board redrew.
expected: A clip shown upright in Source is upright in the film with Rotation 0, Scale 100
where: Program monitor / Effect Controls › Motion on shot 1
suggestion: When the tool uprights a clip itself, the first pass must not add its own rotation; flag a shot whose Motion fights the clip's own orientation

title: Clicking the ruler to look at a proposed title hides the title's card
wanted: Park on the title's frame, then use the proposed title's 'edit by hand'
did: With the title PROPOSED, clicked the timeline ruler at ~2 s, then clicked where 'edit by hand' had been
happened: The ruler click deselected the shot and the whole Designed Effects panel went to 'FX · select a shot on the timeline': the waiting proposal disappeared from the panel (only the tab's '1' badge says it still exists). I had to find and click the shot again to get the card back. You always want to park on the title and then adjust it.
expected: The card stays while I move the playhead, or the panel lists all waiting proposals
suggestion: Keep showing the proposed effect's card (or a list of waiting ones) when nothing is selected

title: After typing a timecode, the monitor first showed a different frame with a bigger title, then settled
wanted: Park exactly on 00:00:02:07 to judge the opening title
did: Clicked the Program timecode, typed 00000207, Enter; screenshot 2.5 s later, again 3 s later
happened: The first look (051) showed a frame framed differently (laptop centred, people further right) with the title drawn noticeably larger; three later looks at the same 00:00:02:07 (046/052/054) all show the settled frame with the smaller title. No 'loading' sign during the wrong draw. On a busy machine maybe, but for a finisher a monitor that shows a wrong size of title for seconds is misleading.
expected: The real frame, or a visible 'drawing…' sign until it is ready
where: Program monitor after a typed timecode

title: 'Lower-third' card says 'lower left' but the picture shows a huge name plate mid-frame, right, over Spencer's chest
wanted: A name super for Spencer in the lower third, bottom left
did: Designed Effects on shot 2: "Name lower-third: 'Spencer' on the bearded man in the grey fleece, bottom left, fades in and out, about 3 seconds" (30 s); parked at 00:00:09:00
happened: Card: 'names Spencer … on a dark plate in the lower left … ✓ checked · inside the frame'. The monitor shows 'Spencer' at title size (letters ~60 px tall on a 470 px monitor, about an eighth of the frame height), on a dark plate from the frame's middle to the right edge region, at 35–55 % of the height: over his chest, nowhere near lower left. 'Inside the frame' is true, but the check passes a plate that is in the wrong place and the wrong size, and the description is not what is drawn.
expected: Lower-left at lower-third size, or the card saying where it really is (x/y) so the words can't lie
where: Designed Effects card vs Program monitor, shot 2
suggestion: Check the placement against what was asked (lower third = below ~65 % of the height), and describe the drawn place, not the intended one

title: Hand fields jump down as the check line changes, so the next click lands on the wrong control
wanted: Type x, then y, for the Spencer plate
did: Double-clicked x, typed 22, Tab; double-clicked where y had been, Ctrl+A, typed 82
happened: After x changed, the card's check line became '✗ a bar is cut off by the edge of the frame · Fit to frame' and every control below moved down ~9 px. My second double-click missed the y box; Ctrl+A then selected all 13 shots on the timeline (scope chip 'Shots 1–13', panel switched to shot 13's empty design box) and the size went from 0.50 to 0.71 by itself. Nothing in the cut broke that I can see, but I lost the card and had to find shot 2 again.
expected: Controls that stay put while the check re-runs
suggestion: Reserve the check line's height; keep Ctrl+A inside the card from selecting the timeline

title: Title 'size' means different things per effect: Spencer at 0.40 is drawn bigger than the opening title at 0.69
wanted: A modest lower-third, smaller than the opening title
did: Set the Spencer plate's size to 0.40 (opening title is 0.69); parked at 00:00:09:00
happened: Spencer's letters are ~60 px tall on the 470 px monitor (about 13 % of the frame height), larger than 'Copper Mountain · February 2026' at 0.69. Also the green box the monitor drew while I set the size (075) was smaller than the plate that is really drawn (076). I can't set a size by number and know what I get.
expected: One size scale for every title (e.g. % of frame height), and the guide box the size of what is drawn
where: Designed Effects › edit by hand › size

title: After the AI swapped shots 1 and 2, the 'opening title' went with its shot to 0:03.7 and the film now opens on the 'Spencer' super; no word about it
wanted: Try an AI reorder of the opening and keep my opening title at the head of the film
did: Ask the AI (whole sequence): 'swap the first two shots…' (9 s), reviewed the one-line proposal, Accept; parked at 1, 2, 6, 7 s
happened: Titles are glued to their shots: the film now starts with the 'Spencer' lower-third over the first frame, and 'Copper Mountain · February 2026' shows from ~3.7 s in the middle of the bar shot. The proposal said only 'Move shot 2 before shot 1'; it did not mention that an opening title and a name super would move with them. Sticking to the shot is right for a name super, wrong for an opening title.
expected: The proposal says which titles move with the shots, or an opening/end title is pinned to the film's start/end
where: Ask the AI › reorder proposal; Designed Effects titles
suggestion: List riding effects in the proposal ('the opening title moves to 0:03.7') and offer to keep it at the head

title: Dragging Cross Dissolve onto an edit did nothing, and the board then ignored clicks until I reloaded
wanted: Put a dissolve on the edit between shot 9 (GX010489) and 10 (GX010491)
did: Effects › Video Transitions › Dissolve › Cross Dissolve: dragged it to the edit point at 1:06:18 on V1, twice (fast, then slow with pauses)
happened: No drop highlight, no dissolve on the edit, undo unchanged. Afterwards 'Cross Dissolve' stayed greyed in the list as if still held, the menu bar (File, Sequence) would not open and panel tabs ignored clicks; Escape and extra clicks did not free it. I reloaded the page. My script's drag may not finish a browser drag the way a hand does, so this may be the rig; but there is no other way I found to add a transition (no menu item, no right-click).
expected: A drop marker on the edit, then a dissolve; or a 'Apply transition' menu item / Ctrl+D
suggestion: Offer Sequence › Apply Cross Dissolve (Ctrl+D) at the edit under the playhead as a second way

title: A transition still can't be selected by hand: clicking the dissolve selects the shot
wanted: Check and shorten the dissolve the AI just added (follows old FINISH-11)
did: Asked the AI for a 12-frame Cross Dissolve 9→10 (8 s, honest note that shot 10 has no handle), Accept all; zoomed in, clicked the purple dissolve block; right-click earlier gave only 'Ask AI about this… / Look deeper…'
happened: Effect Controls shows 'Shot 10 · GX010491' with Motion/Opacity/…; nothing for the transition (no duration, alignment, remove). The Effects panel tooltip says to drag a transition onto an edit, but my drag never dropped (FINISH-09). So by hand a transition is still untouchable; only words to the AI or Ctrl+Z.
expected: Click the transition → its duration and alignment in Effect Controls, Delete removes it

title: The AI says to 'open a 9:16 sequence' and ask again, but nothing in the tool can make one
wanted: A vertical 9:16 phone version beside the 16:9 master (follows old FINISH-14)
did: Asked the AI (whole sequence): 'make a vertical 9:16 version of this film for phones, keep this 16:9 one as it is' (~40 s); then looked by hand: Sequence › Sequence Settings…, Export › Frame Size, the cut switcher's 'save a copy'
happened: The answer is honest and left my film alone: 'I can't make the vertical version … none can create a second sequence or change its frame shape … If I reframed the shots here … I'd be changing the 16:9 cut you want to keep.' Good. But it ends 'Once a 9:16 sequence of this film is open, ask again and I'll reframe it shot by shot': Sequence Settings has only Timebase, Export's Frame Size lists only 16:9 sizes, and a saved copy is 16:9 too. So the advice sends me looking for a thing that isn't there. A finisher can't deliver a vertical from here.
expected: Either a frame-shape setting (9:16) on a copy of the cut, or the AI saying plainly 'vertical isn't in Roughcut yet'
where: Ask the AI / Sequence Settings / Export Frame Size

title: No way to set the music bed's level: the Audio tab has none, A2 can't be selected, and the AI says it can't see any music
wanted: Bring the music bed down 4 dB under the whole film
did: Audio tab (Music bed, dip under talk off/a little/a lot, more › fade in 1.5 s / fade out 4 s); clicked and right-clicked the music on A2; asked the AI 'turn the music bed down by 4 dB overall' (12 s)
happened: The Audio tab has ducking amount and fades but no gain for the bed. Clicking the music on A2 selects nothing and Effect Controls stays on the sequence; right-click gives no menu. The AI answered: 'I can't find a music bed in this cut … A2 exists, but nothing is listed on it … you can lower it in the Audio panel' — which has no such control. So the bed's overall level is whatever the tool picked; I can't mix it.
expected: A level (dB) for the music bed in the Audio tab or on the A2 clip, and the AI aware of the bed it is mixing under
where: Audio tab / A2 / Ask the AI
